content.title: Justin Bieber Brings Out Billie Eilish, Big Sean, and More Stars During Coachella 2026 Performance
content.text: Justin Bieber Brings Out Billie Eilish, Big Sean, and More Stars During Coachella 2026 Performance0 seconds of 1 minute, 16 secondsVolume 0%Justin Bieber Brings Out Billie Eilish, Big Sean, and More Stars During Coachella 2026 PerformanceJustin Bieber was somebody to love at Coachella weekend two. During the “Baby” hitmaker’s April 18 headlining set, he brought a stacked lineup of stars out to the desert for a nostalgic performance at the annual music festival. Take, for instance, Billie Eilish, who joined him onstage during his performance of “One Less Lonely Girl.” In an April 19 Instagram Stories video posted by Claudia Sulewski—Billie’s soon-to-be sister-in-law—the “Birds of a Feather” singer can be seen enjoying Justin’s April 18 performance from the crowd before his wife Hailey Bieber puts an arm around her. The pair can then be seen grooving to the music together before Hailey gives Billie—donning a purple windbreaker and black track pants—a nudge past the barricade to join the “Beauty and a Beat” singer onstage. In a separate clip shared to social media, Billie fangirls as she climbs onstage to meet Justin, collapsing with her hands over her face as she takes in the surreal moment.The “Peaches” singer—who shares 19-month-old son Jack with Hailey—wasted no time in helping Billie to her feet before leading her to a stool in front of the Coachella crowd, where he serenaded her to his 2009 hit with his arms around her.Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for CoachellaBut the celeb cameos didn’t stop there. After all, SZA joined the 32-year-old to perform their 2023 acoustic remix of “Snooze” while Sexyy Red came out to accompany Justin in a duet for their 2025 song “Sweet Spot.” But perhaps the biggest crowd pleaser of the night was an appearance made by Big Sean, who joined Justin in performing the pair’s massive 2012 hit “As Long As You Love Me.” Following the performance, Big Sean (born Sean Michael Leonard Anderson) took time to give Justin his flowers.Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella“I just gotta stay, brother, that you know God has his hands on you,” Sean said onstage in footage shared to social media. “You dedicated your whole life to this, man. You gave us your whole life.” “Directly or indirectly, I think you taught all of us to believe in ourselves,” he added. “You taught us all, showed us what purpose was. I’m not trying to name your albums, it’s just a coincidence.” After noting how he’s had a chance to meet Hailey and baby Jack, the “Blessings” rapper expressed how proud he is of Justin for overcoming his darkest times. “I’ve seen a lot of the things you’ve gone through,” Sean said. “I’ve seen you at times where it wasn’t always beautiful, but you fought through it. And in a world where everyone’s trying to take over the world, you give over the world, bro.” For more stars who were spotted at Coachella 2026, read on… Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for CoachellaJustin Bieber & Billie EilishOne less lonely girl.
